project.description: The application to set up. Defaults to the workspace's default project.

styles.description: Import ashen-ui/styles/index.css into the project's global stylesheet.

tailwind.description: Also import the Tailwind bridge, ashen-ui/styles/tailwind.css.

bootGuard.description: Insert the app-wide data-sn-app-boot snippet into index.html and its global stylesheet, which hides the app until the first render so zoneless host bindings don't flash.
